original_test_intent: Verify that the platform-defined F2 Previous Values function restores a deliberately changed BIOS option to its known immediately prior value.
original_method: On an approved non-critical option, record the original value, create one controlled unsaved change, press F2, visually confirm restoration of the precise prior value, then exit without an unintended commit.
manual_activity: A human must establish the controlled BIOS value transition, press F2, visually verify the exact prior value, and ensure the final configuration is safe.
required_inputs: F2 Previous Values mapping for the exact BIOS
Console/operator, commit policy and recovery window
safety_requirements: Do not reuse the neighboring F2 setup-entry interpretation.
Avoid boot, security, storage, thermal and power-critical options.
Do not save the changed value unless separately approved.
Stop if F2 scope or restored state is ambiguous.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the three-state comparison and platform inventory.
Analyze supplied visual evidence and post-boot logs.
Report observed differences without pressing the key or setting the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the option/state transition and boot window.
Perform the change/F2 observation and preserve evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects SSH as proof of Previous Values behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the BIOS UI transition; validated remote KVM can carry the manual interaction but does not automate acceptance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F2, previous-value restoration and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture original, changed, post-F2 restored and final exit states in one timestamped sequence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board/BIOS after F2 mapping confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-supplied BIOS key and option specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the otherwise implicit prior-value precondition and final-state control explicit.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Without a deliberate changed state, F2 can appear to work without proving restoration.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose a reversible option and whether the restored value is saved or canceled, but must record every state and preserve the F2 restore semantics.
expected_evidence: Timestamped F2 and restored prior value
Final configuration/normal boot and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: This source row consistently defines F2 as Previous Values. Its different meaning in another hotkey case is contextual, not an internal conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The restoration intent is clear; project-specific option/state inputs affect readiness, not permanent feasibility.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its state-transition and recovery controls while permitting validated remote KVM.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly distinguishes this F2 function from setup entry and isolates duplicate-code history.

review_improvement: Requires a known changed state, preventing a no-op F2 press from being accepted as proof of Previous Values restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: The result depends on a visible BIOS state transition and configuration control, so preparation/log checks can be automated but the acceptance action remains human and MANUAL ONLY.

source_provenance.history: Repository exact-code search and distinct row 1457 upgrade variant

no_automatic_retry: Do not create another configuration change or repeat F2 after an unexpected result; preserve state and obtain engineer direction.
